title: Operator Basics
description: This Paper plugin adds a list of commands to manage your server easily.
body:
# Operator Basics

This plugin adds many diverse operator only commands to control your server. 

### Commands

```
/invis
```
Makes yourself invisible to other people, but you can still be seen on the player list.

```
/uninvis
```
Makes yourself visible again.

```
/mute <player>
```
Silences another player so they can't use the chat.

```
/unmute <player>
```
Allows a muted player to talk again.

```
/freeze <player>
```
Stops another player from moving and looking around.

```
/unfreeze <player>
```
Allows a frozen player to move and look around again.

```
/endersee <player>
```
Allows you to see into the specified players enderchest.

```
/thunder
```
Strikes any entity in a 15 block radius with lighting until dead or despawned.

```
/nothunder
```
Stops thunder from striking every entity in a 15 block radius.
